title: Requirement for specific bacterial genome maintenance pathways in repair of C8-linked pyrrolobenzodiazepine (PBD) bi-aryl monomer-mediated DNA damage
authors: Joseph AM; Nahar K; Daw S; Hasan MM; Lo R; Le TBK; Rahman KM; Badrinarayanan A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PBD单体在细菌中引起的DNA损伤修复机制，属于纯实验生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pyrrolobenzodiazepines (PBDs) are naturally occurring DNA binding compounds that possess anti-tumor and anti-bacterial activity. Chemical modifications of PBDs can result in improved DNA binding, sequence specificity and enhanced efficacy. More recently, synthetic PBD monomers have shown promise as payloads for antibody drug conjugates and antibacterial agents. The precise mechanism of action of these PBD monomers and their role in causing DNA damage remains to be elucidated. Here we characterized the damage-inducing potential of two C8-linked PBD bi-aryl monomers in Caulobacter crescentus and investigated the strategies employed by cells to repair the same. We show that these compounds cause DNA damage and efficiently kill bacteria, in a manner comparable to the extensively used DNA cross-linking agent mitomycin-C (MMC). However, in stark contrast to MMC which employs a mutagenic lesion tolerance pathway, we implicate essential functions for error-free mechanisms in repairing PBD monomer-mediated damage. We find that survival is severely compromised in cells lacking nucleotide excision repair and to a lesser extent, in cells with impaired recombination-based repair. Loss of nucleotide excision repair leads to significant increase in double-strand breaks, underscoring the critical role of this pathway in mediating repair of PBD-induced DNA lesions. Together, our study provides comprehensive insights into how mono-alkylating DNA-targeting therapeutic compounds like PBD monomers challenge cell growth, and identifies the specific mechanisms employed by the cell to counter the same.
abstract_zh: 吡咯并苯二氮杂卓类化合物（PBDs）是天然存在的DNA结合化合物，具有抗肿瘤和抗菌活性。对PBDs进行化学修饰可改善其DNA结合能力、序列特异性及增强功效。近年来，合成的PBD单体在抗体药物偶联物和抗菌剂中展现出作为有效载荷的前景。这些PBD单体精确的作用机制及其在引起DNA损伤中的作用仍有待阐明。在此，我们表征了两种C8连接的PBD双芳基单体在 *Caulobacter crescentus* 中诱导损伤的潜力，并研究了细胞用于修复这些损伤的策略。我们表明，这些化合物能引起DNA损伤并有效杀死细菌，其效果与广泛使用的DNA交联剂丝裂霉素C（MMC）相当。然而，与采用致突变性损伤耐受途径的MMC形成鲜明对比，我们暗示无错误机制在修复PBD单体介导的损伤中发挥关键作用。我们发现，缺乏核苷酸切除修复的细胞存活率严重受损，而在重组修复受损的细胞中影响较小。核苷酸切除修复的缺失导致双链断裂显著增加，强调了该途径在介导PBD诱导的DNA损伤修复中的关键作用。综合来看，我们的研究为单烷化DNA靶向治疗化合物如PBD单体如何挑战细胞生长提供了全面见解，并确定了细胞用于应对此挑战的具体机制。
